title: Claude Code fixes a security issue in zstd response decoding
summary: Anthropic reports a security fix for decoding zstd-compressed responses in Claude Code 2.1.325. The release notes do not describe the impact, attack prerequisites or affected version range.

severity.rationale: The vendor confirms a decoder security fix but supplies too little detail to establish a higher impact level. This provisional next-update classification reflects limited evidence and should be reassessed when details appear.
